question: For the same fixed selected first record and equal-flux public action pair, is a complete next-first charge-law comparison under each previously frozen later-fault key within the present exact-projector budget, and is there any necessary cross-round operator opening?
role: Read-only deterministic prerequisite to a possible fixed-future exact next-first law; no Born evaluation, causal-benefit, information-gain, risk or noisy-schedule claim
source_basis: J7M exact two-action complete second public laws and 34 positive action-conditioned second prefixes
J7I prior fixed later-fault keys [0] and [4]
J7D cross-round anticommutator as a necessary-only structural screen
J6L/J6M periodic operator geometry and vacuum orbit

model.geometry_and_state: Same paper-normalized periodic L=2 ideal D4 projector system and anyon-free J6M orbit used by J7M; private initial red-X error [0,4,3] and the selected complete first public record of exact mass 1/4 are unchanged
model.public_actions: Relation-free public red-X corrections [0] and [1,30,32,34,35], whose trivial closed-loop difference gives equal public second and, under each matched future-fault key, next flux; the long action is not known to be emitted by frozen JIT
model.public_private_boundary: J7M's full binary first/second records and declared correction are public. Later physical fault, residual/final red support, projector operators and cost/commutator traces are private diagnostic internals; none are offered to a decoder
model.feasibility_target: For each positive second prefix and fixed later fault, count next eligible stars, cross-round anticommuting second/next operator pairs, and the ordered-moment terms that the unchanged J7E exact full-law implementation would spend on its denominator plus one-site next marginals. This is an implementation work estimate, not a mathematical lower bound or a Born law.
model.independent_unit_uncertainty: Deterministic exhaustive four-cell structural/cost audit of the 34 existing positive second-prefix records; no stochastic unit or uncertainty interval

matrix.term_formula: With first block f=2 and second block k variable projectors, the current exact engine counts 2^(2f+k) terms for one second-prefix denominator and 2^(2f+2k+1) for each eligible next-site one-bit numerator; multiply the latter by eligible next-site count and existing positive second-prefix count. Do not compute any of these Born terms.
branches: both public actions crossed with both fixed future-fault keys
complete next-public flux/eligibility and second-next operator commutator screen
current exact-engine denominator and one-site cost projection compared with the prior 65,536-term ceiling

competing_outcomes.under_existing_budget: The complete current-engine one-site stage for both actions and both future keys fits the prior 65,536-term ceiling; a separately registered Born-law contract may be considered if other public/model gates also pass
competing_outcomes.over_existing_budget: The current-engine one-site stage already exceeds the prior ceiling; do not run or enlarge a complete next-first law now, and investigate a bounded analytical/symmetry reduction before any new resource request
competing_outcomes.structural_null: No cross-round anticommutator on these four cells; this weakens one memory route but does not prove their full next laws equal or establish risk
competing_outcomes.invalid: Any pin, second-law mass/public schema, action/future/final flux, topology, operator or budget check fails; no next-law inference

acceptance: Eight pins pass before and after and J7M/J7I action/future provenance replays
All four action/future cells retain the 34 prior positive second public prefixes without outcome selection or private fields in public records
At each matched future key both actions have identical complete next public flux and sector eligibility reconciles
All second-next operator-pair checks are bounded and counted, and their necessary-only interpretation is explicit

Current-engine denominator/one-site term projection is exact from the frozen counting rule and compared with the prior 65,536-term ceiling; zero Born, next-law, noisy-history, arm, bootstrap or caller work
stop_rule: Fail closed on any pin, action/future, public-prefix, flux/eligibility, commutator, CPU or pair-count gate. No complete next-first Born law or policy evaluation in this tick. A work projection above the existing ceiling does not authorize increasing that ceiling; register a separate analytical-reduction prerequisite instead.
